svg.text: A handwritten note becomes a reviewed, structured entry in Microsoft 365 —
captured on paper, interpreted by AI, approved by a human, then auto-routed.
Handwritten pages are written and saved on-device.
The synced notebook file lands in a watched OneDrive folder.
Triggers on the update, pulls the file, and orchestrates every step downstream.
Handwritten content is read and interpreted into meaning.
Parsed entries and workflow state are held for the next steps.
Structured entries are compiled into one human-readable brief.
The brief is sent for review with three possible outcomes.
Sends an edit instruction back into the pipeline.
The approved brief is checked for completeness before routing.
Each entry is tagged and sent to its destination.
Microsoft To Do → Microsoft 365 Calendar, when a date is present
